Congratulations on your upcoming wedding! Setting up a registry is one of the fun parts of wedding planning. To help you find the best options for cookware, bedding, and kitchen tools, here's a breakdown of top retailers, considering selection, quality, price points, and registry features.  Most couples register at **2-3 different retailers** to offer a variety of price points and styles.  ---  ### Top Retailers for Home Goods Registries  #### 1. **Crate & Barrel** *   **Best For:** Modern, stylish home goods, high-quality basics, and unique pieces. *   **What they excel at:** Excellent selection of cookware (All-Clad, Le Creuset, their own C&B brand), dinnerware, glassware, kitchen tools, and contemporary bedding. They also have furniture and decor. *   **Registry Features:**     *   **Completion Discount:** Typically 15-20% off remaining items for 6 months after your wedding.     *   **Easy Returns/Exchanges:** Very generous policy.     *   **Group Gifting:** Available for larger items.     *   **Registry Events:** Often host in-store events for registrants.     *   **Thank You Note Manager:** Helps track gifts. *   **Why it's great:** A fantastic all-around option if you appreciate modern design and quality.  #### 2. **Williams Sonoma** *   **Best For:** Serious home cooks, high-end kitchen essentials, and gourmet items. *   **What they excel at:** Unparalleled selection of premium cookware (All-Clad, Staub, Le Creuset, Wüsthof knives), small appliances (KitchenAid, Vitamix), baking tools, and specialty food items. They also carry some elegant dinnerware and linens. *   **Registry Features:**     *   **Completion Discount:** Similar to Crate & Barrel, usually 10-20% off for 6 months.     *   **Expert Advice:** Staff are very knowledgeable about kitchen products.     *   **Group Gifting:** Available. *   **Why it's great:** If you love to cook and want to invest in top-tier kitchen equipment that will last a lifetime, this is your go-to.  #### 3. **Macy's** *   **Best For:** A traditional department store experience with a vast selection across all home categories. *   **What they excel at:** Wide range of cookware brands, bedding (multiple thread counts, styles), bath towels, small appliances, dinnerware, and home decor. You can find items at various price points. *   **Registry Features:**     *   **Completion Discount:** Often 10-20% off for a period after the wedding.     *   **"Star Rewards" Program:** Earn points on registry purchases.     *   **"MyRegistry" Integration:** Can link to other registries.     *   **Returns:** Easy returns/exchanges. *   **Why it's great:** A solid choice for comprehensive coverage, especially if you have guests who prefer shopping at a classic department store.  #### 4. **Target** *   **Best For:** Everyday essentials, budget-friendly options, and fun, trendy decor. *   **What they excel at:** Great for filling in gaps with affordable kitchen tools, storage solutions, extra bedding sets, stylish decor items, and small appliances. They've significantly upped their game in home goods quality. *   **Registry Features:**     *   **Completion Discount:** 15% off remaining items closer to your wedding date.     *   **Easy Returns:** Up to a year after your wedding.     *   **Group Gifting:** Available.     *   **Universal Registry Integration:** Can add items from other websites. *   **Why it's great:** An excellent secondary registry to complement a more high-end one, ensuring there are plenty of affordable gift options for guests.  #### 5. **Amazon** *   **Best For:** Unbeatable selection, competitive pricing, and ultimate convenience. *   **What they excel at:** Literally everything. You can find every brand of cookware, every style of bedding, and any kitchen gadget imaginable. Great for niche items or specific models you can't find elsewhere. *   **Registry Features:**     *   **Completion Discount:** Usually 10% (Prime members get 20%) on remaining items.     *   **Universal Registry:** You can add items from any website using their "Add to Amazon Assistant" button.     *   **Extended Returns:** 180 days for registry gifts.     *   **Free Shipping:** For Prime members. *   **Why it's great:** Almost a must-have primary or secondary registry due to its sheer versatility and guest familiarity.  #### 6. **Zola** *   **Best For:** A modern, all-in-one universal registry that combines products, experiences, and cash funds. *   **What they excel at:** Allows you to add products directly from Zola's curated shop (which includes many popular home brands like Le Creuset, Casper, Dyson) *or* link to items from *any other website* (like Pottery Barn, West Elm, etc.). You can also register for honeymoon funds, experiences, or cash. *   **Registry Features:**     *   **Completion Discount:** 20% off for 6 months after your wedding.     *   **Free Shipping & Returns:** On Zola-fulfilled items.     *   **Virtual Exchange:** Guests can easily exchange gifts before they're even shipped to you.     *   **Thank You Note Manager:** Excellent tracking system. *   **Why it's great:** If you want flexibility, a sleek user experience, and the ability to ask for non-physical gifts, Zola is a fantastic primary registry.  ---  ### Key Features to Look For When Choosing a Registry  *   **Completion Discount:** A percentage off items left on your registry after the wedding. This is a huge perk! *   **Return/Exchange Policy:** How easy is it for you to return or exchange gifts you receive? Look for extended windows and hassle-free processes. *   **Wide Selection & Price Points:** Ensure there are items across different categories and budgets so all guests can find something. *   **Ease of Use (for you & guests):** Is the website intuitive? Is it easy to add items, manage your list, and for guests to find and purchase gifts? *   **Group Gifting:** Allows multiple guests to contribute to a larger, more expensive item. *   **Cash/Honeymoon Fund Options:** If you're open to receiving contributions for experiences or savings. *   **Thank You Note Tracker:** A lifesaver for remembering who gave what!  ---  ### Recommendations Based on Your Needs:  *   **For the serious home chef & quality seeker:** **Williams Sonoma** + **Crate & Barrel** *   **For the modern, stylish couple who wants everything:** **Zola** (using their universal feature to pull from Crate & Barrel, West Elm, etc.) + **Target** (for everyday items) *   **For a comprehensive, traditional approach:** **Macy's** + **Amazon** *   **For maximum flexibility and convenience:** **Zola** (as your primary, linking everything) + **Amazon** (as a backup for anything Zola can't easily handle)  Have fun building your dream home together!
